name: Daniel Jones
story: Daniel Jones's 2019 University of Canterbury master's thesis examined the integration of BIM and GIS. The research proposed a workflow integrating BIM and GIS for urban risk and resilience, using Christchurch and the Taiora Queen Elizabeth II recreation and sports centre as a case. It explored semantic and web-service issues as well as the geographic relationship between a detailed building model and wider spatial context. The thesis used the term digital twin.
